summary: dnf5 options: allow_downgrade, allowerasing, auto-installing module dependencies, autoremove, best, and bugfix-only updates.
questions: Can dnf5 module install its own python dependency?
How do I allow downgrades with dnf5?
How do I remove unused dependencies with dnf5?

answer_card.title: dnf5 parameters (part 1)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `allow_downgrade` (no; may be non-idempotent)
- `allowerasing` (no)
- `auto_install_module_deps` (true)
- `autoremove` (no)
- `best`: default from distro
- `bugfix` (no): bugfix updates only with `latest`
